name: svolo
description: A shared browser and workspace for human-directed agents.
author: 0xfunboy

scripts.start: node scripts/build-core.mjs && electron-vite build && node bin/svolo.mjs
scripts.dist: node scripts/check-build-host.mjs darwin && node scripts/build-core.mjs && node scripts/build-computer-use.mjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/check-build-host.mjs linux && node scripts/build-core.mjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux --publish never
scripts.dist:windows: node scripts/check-build-host.mjs windows && node scripts/build-core.mjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win --publish never
